prompts.prompt: Create one finished landscape game UI artwork, edge-to-edge opaque composition, aspect ratio 2.52:1 (ideally 1512x600). Use case: stylized-concept. Intended for a wide Support ability card in WarlineCapture. Match the provided reference's faceted low-poly military game style, angular geometry, olive/tan materials and painterly polygon lighting. No UI, no text, no lettering, no icons/badges, no borders, no watermark, no blank margins. Main subject must fit completely inside the central 70% of the width and central 75% of height, so center-cover cropping to a 1.8:1 detail preview retains the subject. Background fills the whole image. Reference is the actual game's smoke grenade, preserve its identity: olive cylindrical canister, muted red band, angular metal top, side safety lever. A large grenade tilted diagonally across the middle of a dark blue-gray smoky atmosphere. Layered soft polygon smoke billows extend to every edge, crisp grenade readable against them, grounded cinematic lighting. Single grenade, no explosion or flames.
